ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 80 percent high-intensity white pixels to 20 percent low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black margins along the trailing edge and distal tips; diffuse black mottling and stippling concentrated along the trailing edge; discrete linear black streaks radiating from the peduncle towards the leading edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression; apex situated at the vertical centerline of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography; high-frequency serrations with variable pixel amplitudes forming a jagged profile along both lobes, isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to sharp upward-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular, circular high-contrast pixel nodes concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes; a singular, isolated circular ring-shaped scar located in the upper-medial region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, dark linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally across the white ventral surface, most prominent on the medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips; multiple parallel linear rake marks across the fluke surface; a distinct circular ring mark on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, perfectly circular dark ring-shaped pixel pattern located on the upper interior quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
